answer: An identity earns its seat through Certified youth worker session log with youth workers endorsement, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. A farm running 429 aliases would need 429 separate proofs, each costing about 104 POA or 17 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Hold the relic up to the light, weigh the kernel of the attack, and keep the cedar of the verdict where everyone can audit it. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
